# Khun Camp

> Khun Camp is a content production service for founder-led brands in Southeast Asia, run on its own AI-systems workflow. We handle strategy, scripts, filming direction, editing, posting and community replies. The founder films; we do the rest.

Website: https://khuncamp.com/
Founder: Shawn Arrington (former US Army, YouTube creator)
Contact: Shawn@getkhuncamp.com
Book a short call: https://khuncamp.com/book

## Who it is for

Founder-led brands where the founder is still the bottleneck between a good idea and a posted video. Clients are across Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Thailand and the Philippines. The system runs remotely.

## What we do

- Strategy and content pillars, with a 90-day plan
- Scripts and filming direction
- Editing and production (long-form plus 3 to 5 shorts cut from each video)
- Posting, scheduling, and replies to comments and DMs in the founder's voice
- Monthly strategy call and report

About 2.5 hours of the founder's own time per video, plus 3.5 hours working together. Khun Camp handles the remaining 9.0 hours of the 15.0 hours of work per video.

## Pricing

- The Build: $4,000, one time. Sets up the content system: brand and audience audit, voice guide, content pillars and 90-day roadmap, visual and template system, analytics tracking.
- The Retainer: $2,500 a month, three-month minimum. Runs the system: scripts, editing, production, posting, scheduling, community replies, monthly strategy call and report.
- Exact scope is confirmed on a short call before anything starts. This is the only published price.

## Proof

One gaming reaction YouTube channel (KhunShawn) went from 91.6K to 626.3K views in 28 days (Sep 17 to Oct 14, 2026), with 27x more subscribers gained than the baseline window. One channel's result, not a guarantee. Source: YouTube Studio.
